events.name: Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix 2026 (first SG Sprint weekend)
events.attendees: 260,000+ over race weekend, large international share
events.rationale: Night race plus Singapore's first F1 Sprint (final Sprint round of the season). Padang Stage line-up confirmed: CORTIS and JJ Lin (Fri 9 Oct), The Killers (Sat 10 Oct), Lana Del Rey closing Sun 11 Oct, plus Janet Jackson, Mark Ronson, Zara Larsson and DJ Snake. Grand Prix Season Singapore runs 2-11 Oct citywide. Historically the strongest citywide compression weekend of the year - international adults staying 3-5 nights in/near CBD. Comp scrape for 10 Oct confirms: most comps 2-4x normal ADR, several sold out.
events.best_fit: All sectors - The Quays and City Hall closest to circuit; Chinatown and Kampong Glam overflow

events.name: TOKEN2049 Singapore
events.rationale: Crypto's largest global gathering, deliberately scheduled into F1 week; back-to-back with the GP it creates a 5-6 night compression block Oct 6-12. Attendees are international adult professionals with strong side-event activity across CBD shophouse districts.
events.best_fit: Chinatown and The Quays (CBD proximity, side events); City Hall

events.name: SuperReturn Asia 2026
events.rationale: Asia's largest private capital conference; senior international finance delegates staying 3-4 nights in/near CBD with heavy side-meeting activity. Adult business travellers, strong rate tolerance. Comp scrape for Mon 28 Sep shows comps still at base rates - pricing opportunity if delegates book late.
events.best_fit: The Quays and City Hall (CBD/finance district adjacency); Chinatown

events.name: BIGBANG 20th Anniversary World Tour <XX : COSMOS>
events.rationale: First full BIGBANG reunion tour in a decade; K-pop stadium shows in Singapore reliably sell out and pull regional fly-in fans staying 1-2 nights. Adult fanbase (20s-40s) fits adults-only positioning.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang); The Quays

events.name: The Weeknd - After Hours Til Dawn Tour
events.attendees: ~50,000 per night, two nights, significant regional fly-in
events.rationale: Stadium-scale international act across two nights, landing on the opening weekend of Grand Prix Season Singapore. Past comparable stadium shows drove regional fly-in fans staying 1-2 nights. Adult-skewing audience fits adults-only positioning. Overlaps the SuperReturn Asia tail and stacks with ITZY at Indoor Stadium on 3 Oct - strong early-Oct compression.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang); The Quays

events.name: Post Malone - The BIG ASS Stadium World Tour (two shows)
events.attendees: ~50,000 per show across two nights, strong regional fly-in
events.rationale: Two National Stadium dates now confirmed (Fri 25 and Sun 27 Sep) rather than a single show - a three-night demand window rather than a weekend spike, with Don Toliver supporting. Stadium acts of this scale reliably pull SEA fly-in fans who stay overnight. Mostly young adults, fits adults-only properties. Note: second date is an upgrade on last run's single-show assumption.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang); The Quays

events.name: ITB Asia 2026 (with co-located travel-tech events)
events.rationale: Asia's leading travel trade show; multi-day international delegate base staying 3-4 nights, historically converts into CBD midscale occupancy.
events.best_fit: Chinatown and The Quays; City Hall

events.name: Singapore International Energy Week (SIEW) 2026
events.venue: Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre
events.rationale: Flagship global energy platform with ministers, executives and delegates flying in for the full week; international adult business travellers staying 3-5 nights in/near CBD.
events.best_fit: The Quays and City Hall; Chinatown

events.name: Mariah Carey - The Celebration of Mimi
events.rationale: Legacy international act landing mid TOKEN2049/F1 week - adds to an already compressed Oct 6-12 block. Adult 30s-50s audience fits adults-only positioning; arena scale caps room-night volume.
events.best_fit: City Hall and Kampong Glam; The Quays

events.name: Singapore Night Festival 2026 ('Myths and Legends')
events.attendees: 500,000+ across three weekends, mostly locals/day visitors with a tourist share
events.rationale: 17th edition confirmed for three weekends, 21 Aug to 5 Sep, 7.30pm-11pm nightly (to midnight Fri/Sat), free admission. Projection mapping across the National Museum, Peranakan Museum, Capitol and Cathay Green - literally on the doorstep of the Kampong Glam/City Hall properties. Audience is heavily local so room-night conversion is modest, but it lifts weekend leisure demand and ADR tolerance in the precinct.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (festival precinct adjacency)

events.name: Singapore IP Week 2026
events.venue: Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre
events.rationale: Government-anchored professional conference; international delegates stay 2-3 nights but total room-night volume is modest versus flagship shows.

events.name: ISPE Singapore Conference & Exhibition 2026
events.rationale: Established regional pharma/biotech conference at Suntec; international delegates stay 2-3 nights near City Hall/CBD, though total volume is modest.
events.best_fit: City Hall and Kampong Glam (Suntec adjacency); The Quays

events.name: Asian Actuarial Conference 2026
events.venue: Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre
events.rationale: Four-day professional conference with international delegates staying most of the week; small volume but long length-of-stay, adult business travellers.

events.name: BEX Asia 2026 (Built Environment Week)
events.rationale: Established regional construction/built-environment trade show; meaningful but partly local/day-attendee audience, so moderate room-night conversion.

events.name: Submarine Networks World 2026
events.attendees: 3,000+ senior executives from the global subsea community
events.rationale: Highly international two-day conference, re-confirmed at 3,000+ senior executives; delegates fly in and stay near CBD. Falls in the same week as the Post Malone stadium dates, so mid-to-late Sep firms up. Still moderate room-night volume on its own.

events.name: ITZY 3rd World Tour <TUNNEL VISION>
events.attendees: ~10,000-12,000, strong SEA regional fly-in (final Asia stop of tour)
events.rationale: K-pop arena show, final Asia stop - reliably pulls regional fly-in fans staying 1-2 nights. Young-adult fanbase fits adults-only positioning. Lands the same night as The Weeknd's second stadium show, stacking Kallang-area demand on Sat 3 Oct.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang); The Quays

events.name: Belle and Sebastian
events.attendees: ~8,000, adult indie audience with a regional fly-in share
events.rationale: New addition this run. Long-running international indie act with a 30s-50s adult following - good fit for adults-only shophouse product. Sunday show so the room-night window is Sat-Sun; audience skews local/regional rather than long-haul, which caps volume.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang); The Quays

events.name: Firdhaus - Flat Earth Theory Concert Tour 2026
events.rationale: Tour launch show at Indoor Stadium; Malaysian singer-songwriter with strong cross-causeway following. Part of the audience day-trips from JB, but arena scale still adds Saturday-night room nights near Kallang/CBD. Adult audience.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang)
